generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in Multiple Transaction are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

As per karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
All the documents to be uploaded shall be neatly scanned and the documents scanned shall be in original.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.
Department will not supply any materials, and the cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KP Procurement Portal.
The Employer reserves the rights reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Chikodi during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates mentioned
The Tenderer are should be present during opening of the tender and also submit the uploaded documents duly attested by the Gazetted Officer not below the Rank of Executive Engineer.
Contractors should Registered in KPWD and copy should be uploaded in E-portal Attested by the Gazzeted officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.(As per prevailing rates GST will be Paid Separately)
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delays as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes (excluding GST) as per prevailing Government Orders.
Difference amount should submit at the time of Agreement.
Financial turover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.
If no bid received auto extension will be done by e-proc itself for 2 days.
The contractor should employe only registered labours as per government circular No. PWD/198/HMS/2009/ Dated: 24/06/2009 as per EPF and MP act 1952. In respect of the employe
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) form practicing Chartered Account is preferred.

Appeal as per the Government Ltr No. 572/CRM/2020/PWD-COMM-1-PWD-SEC, Dtated: 09-10-2020 the appeal received in e-proc as per KTTP act/rules within the stipulated time will only the considered. Any written appeal received shall not be considered.

As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022, Dated 11/05/2022 Tender Clause ITT 24.3 If the Tenderer is not ready to make aggrement, Then the EMD amount will be forfeited and tender will be rejected

As per Government Circular No. PWD/48/BMS/2022, Dated 31/05/2024 and KTPP 2000 Rules 26(A) contractor are liable for debarment if contractor does bad quality of work, if contractor fails to complete the work within stupilated period of time and also to follow all other conditions mentioned in the above said Government circular.
The Contractor should maintain the Road in good condition till end tender period.

The Bidder, at his own cost, responsibility and risk, is encouraged to visit, examine and familiarize himself with the Site of Works and its surroundings including source of earth, water, road aggregates, availability of labor etc. and obtain all information that may be necessary for preparing the Bid and entering into a contract for undertaking the maintenance Works. The costs of visiting the site shall be at the Bidders own expense

The Contractor shall maintain the Road Assets in proper condition that comply with the Road Maintenance Standards and ensure users safety and comfort. The maintenance activities shall be so planned that the defects are repaired well before they reach maximum condition asper the permissible tolerance. After issuing the work order the contractor should complete 25% of the work every month.

The Tenderer shall obtain similar the workdone certificate one similar work such as Improvements /Annual Maintenance/Renewal of Asphalt Road from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 (50% of the Amount Put to Tender i.e., Rs. 2.56 Lakhs) in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer(District Level Officer)and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid.

The Tenderer shall achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 of Rs. 5.12 Lakhs (not less than the estimated cost under this contract)
The EMD of Rs. 13,000/- shall be paid in full through e-payment in favour of Executive Engineer, PWD, Chikodi Dn, Chikodi
The Project Completion period is 12 months Including Mansoon
If the contractor has not done the maintenance work satisfactorily in previous years such bids will be rejected.
Supply of tools and plants (spade, pic axe, pan, sickle) required for maintenance work is to be provided by the Tendrer.
Contractor should visit the site and should give certificate that he will maintain the road pot hole free up to the end of tender period

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Annual maintenance & repair of Jaganur via Mamadapur-Jodatti to join SH-18 from from km 0.00 to 7.50 in Chikodi taluka of Belagavi district in the year 2026 27

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908
Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003

Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) - Making  up  loss  of  material/  irregularities  on  shoulder  to  the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Deep Potholes using WBM Gr l & SDBC Gr lI 25 mm thick: Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base  course  using  material  confirming  to  WBM  Grade  -I  with 1ype  Sereenings  standards  wherever  necessary  by  manual means  including  trimming  the  pothole  to  the  required  shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Painting two coats with synthetic enamel paint. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Culverts - Maintenance  of  Hume  pipe  Culvert  by  way  of    Clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet wall and protection work as per drawing and technical specification Clause 1909. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1909

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Retro-Reflectorised Traffic Signs - Providing    and    fixing    of    retro-    reflectorised    cautionary, mandatory  and  informatory  sign  as  per  IRC:67:2022  made of  Class  C  Type  XI  retro  reflective  sheeting  fixed  over   2  mm thick aluminium sheeting vide clause 801.3, 3mm/4mm thick Aluminium composite material sheet depending on the size of the  sign  fixed  over  the  back  support  frame  of  min  25  x  25  x 3mm  angle  mounted  on  a  mild  steel  circular  pipe  65  NB,  3.2 mm thickness firmly fixed to the ground by means of properly designed foundation with M25 grade cement concrete 45 cm x 45 cm x 60 cm, 60 cm below ground level as per approved drawing.The  sign  shall  be  maintained  as  per  section  12  of IRC:67:2022. - 60 cm equilateral triangle

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Chevron Boards - Supply  and  installation  of  retro-  reflective  Chevron  signboards of 600x450mm made out of cube corner micro prismatic grade sheeting confirming to Type XI standards of IRC:67:2022 & ASTM D  4956-09  specification  &  fixed  over  3  mm  thick  Aluminium Composite Panel sheet having minimum 0.30 mm thick aluminum skin  on  both  sides  &  fixed  over  back  support  frame  of  25x25x 3mm MS angle frame. Supported on 75 mm dia OR 75x75x6mm Mild steel with clear height of not less than 2.1 m from the ground level to the bottom of the Sign board & 60 cm below ground level. The sign post should be painted with one coat of red oxide paint and  two  coats  of  synthetic  enamel  paint  of  black  and  white  colour with bands of 30 cm height, firmly fixed to the ground by means of foundation with M 20 grade cement, concrete foundation size of 45 cm  x  45  cm  x  60  cm  including  cost  &  conveyance  of  all  materials, equipment,machinery & Labour with all leads and lifts for satisfactory completion of the work as directed by Engineer incharge.
